navigation_replay.corrected_imu: Calibrated SI inputs. Do not calibrate again. Verify grouping and coning/sculling against every INERTIAL_INCREMENT interval.
navigation_replay.fidelity: Requires complete inputs and C golden validation; never infer operation timing from receive time.
navigation_replay.initial_state: INITIAL_STATE; P0 diagonal and initial velocity; attitude shared with chosen navigation algorithm
navigation_replay.measurement_timestamps: Resolved on the firmware MCU axis. Never subtract configured delay again. Position and velocity times are independent.
navigation_replay.operation_order: Sort ESTIMATOR_STEP.operation_sequence, GNSS_MEASUREMENT.receive_operation_sequence/position_operation_sequence/velocity_operation_sequence, and BARO_MEASUREMENT.operation_sequence within replay_epoch. Zero means not executed. Equal position/velocity operation IDs mean one combined insert.
navigation_replay.prediction: ESTIMATOR_STEP references INERTIAL_INCREMENT.sequence; record order is not execution order across logger queues.
navigation_replay.reanchor: Qualified availability outage only; consistent returning observations at least 1 second, minimum sample count, exhausted bounded normal/inflation attempts; replace only selected state block, variance diagonal from actual R, affected cross covariance zero; apply at measurement time then replay forward.
navigation_replay.replay_generation: Number of successful rewind/replay transactions after this operation or packet.
